name: @aise/world-understanding-substrate
description: AISE Understanding-layer substrate contracts (WORLD-P0-B): the provider-neutral typed adapter contracts for the three Layer-2 substrate families — IFC interpretation (IfcOpenShell semantics + the web-ifc browser-runtime alternative, the GBIM-FT-001 recorded direction), exact geometry (OCCT via OCP/CadQuery reference; engine-neutral contract) and field/scientific data processing (ParaView/VTK). Each family contract is proven implementable WITHOUT its substrate by in-memory deterministic substitution doubles (a real minimal STEP parser for IFC, closed-form analytic math for geometry, in-memory typed transforms for field data). Substrate GUIDs/ids are namespaced external labels and NEVER canonical AISE identity (proven by validators + drills); tolerances are DECLARED in requests and carried verbatim in results (never implicit); every result maps INTO real AISE contract types (Derivation / RealityObject / PropertyAssertion / Measurement of @aise/shared-contracts, proven by decoding the seeds with the shared wire codecs); failures come from the HFX-000 closed vocabulary (imported, never modified). No external substrate is integrated in P0 — real engines are future occupants of the ports this package proves.
